sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.posting_key) AS listings FROM fct_posting f JOIN posting_skills ps_python ON f.posting_key = ps_python.posting_key AND ps_python.skill = 'python' JOIN posting_skills ps_sql ON f.posting_key = ps_sql.posting_key AND ps_sql.skill = 'sql' WHERE f.is_open AND f.remote_us AND f.is_canonical_listing
